title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
text: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion 16/11/2026 Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million). The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
text: On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion. The development is also set to introduce a new international luxury brand to Jeddah through an exclusive co-branded residential concept, further strengthening the city's luxury real estate offering. The expansion follows strong market demand for Dar Global's existing developments in Jeddah, including Trump Plaza and Padel Living, reflecting sustained appetite for high-quality, master-crafted residential and mixed-use developments among both local buyers and foreign investors taking advantage of the new property ownership laws. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , commented: “Saudi Arabia remains one of our most vital growth markets, and Jeddah continues to demonstrate exceptional fundamentals. The success of our existing developments reinforces our confidence in the market and underpins our commitment to delivering world-class residences in the Kingdom.

title: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
text: The success of our existing developments reinforces our confidence in the market and underpins our commitment to delivering world-class residences in the Kingdom. With buyers from 61 nationalities already investing in our Saudi portfolio, we are witnessing accelerating international confidence in the country's real estate sector. This new development marks another significant milestone in our global expansion strategy.” This expanding international participation highlights the Kingdom's rising appeal as a premier destination for global real estate capital, bolstered by comprehensive regulatory reforms and the transformative momentum of Saudi Vision 2030. Further details regarding the development, including its architectural concept, residential offerings, and official launch date, will be unveiled in due course. Share ALL ARTICLES .

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
text: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate 26/10/2026 Dubai, United Arab Emirates Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai. Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
text: Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets. As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements. In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
text: In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the London Stock Exchange and expanded its global portfolio to $23 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV). “Through Dar Global, we built an international platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities,” said Ziad El Chaar, Chairman of Dar Global Capital Partners and CEO of Dar Global. “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework.

title: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
text: “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework. While we pursue acquisitions across leading global gateway cities, Dubai’s exceptional fundamentals offer strong potential for targeted capital deployment.” DGCP provides specialized asset management and advisory capabilities designed to create long-term value for sovereign, institutional, and ultra-high-net-worth investors across international jurisdictions. title: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
text: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest 07/10/2026 Doha, Qatar Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October. The limited release includes three- and five-bedroom Trump Villas, each offering the privacy of a gated community, along with elevated views of the expansive 18-hole golf course, Simaisma beach and the open sea. Residences are now available to purchase, with prices starting from QAR 5 million. Works on site are expected to begin in early 2027, with completion targeted for the end of 2030. Designed to deliver an exclusive coastal lifestyle, the development will be Doha’s first gated golf community, comprising a limited number of villas.

title: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
text: Designed to deliver an exclusive coastal lifestyle, the development will be Doha’s first gated golf community, comprising a limited number of villas. It will feature a dedicated community centre for residents, equipped with padel and tennis courts, alongside a members-only golf and beach club, one of a kind worldwide. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , commented: “The advancement of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, marks a key milestone in delivering high-value, iconically branded real estate in premier regional growth markets. Beyond establishing a world-class championship golf and coastal destination, this project aligns directly with Qatar’s progressive foreign investment and property-linked residency frameworks, offering international investors long-term stability and 100% freehold ownership. Dar Global continues to provide global investors with a structured gateway to high-yielding, lifestyle-driven assets in the GCC.” The destination offers buyers a rare opportunity to secure a residence within one of Qatar’s most ambitious new waterfront masterplans at an early stage.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln 30/09/2026 Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK. Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad. The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text: The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million. Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan. Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text: Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road. Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text: Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
text: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai 06/08/2026 DUBAI, UAE Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, the landmark development continues to progress on schedule as construction advances into its next phase. The appointment reinforces Dar Global's commitment to partnering with leading regional contractors to deliver exceptional quality across every stage of development.

title: Dar Global Appoints Gulf Asia for Trump Tower Dubai
text: The appointment reinforces Dar Global's commitment to partnering with leading regional contractors to deliver exceptional quality across every stage of development. title: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
text: Dar Global & Fendi Casa Announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman 29/06/2026 Muscat, Oman Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas , a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally. The launch unveils 19 thoughtfully designed and exquisitely appointed mansions with direct beach access featuring FENDI Casa's signature Italian craftsmanship and refined high-end design to AIDA, a magnificent, gated community built on a 130-metre-high cliff, surrounded by rocky canyons, pristine beaches, and the scenic Oman coastline. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets.

text: Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets. title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
text: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh 18/06/2026 Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC The award marks a major milestone in the development of Rayana and reflects DarGlobal's continued progress in delivering one of Saudi Arabia's most prestigious residential destinations. The design-and-build contract covers the delivery of the primary infrastructure works supporting the Rayana community, including earthworks, roads, utility networks and access infrastructure across the development.

title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
text: The design-and-build contract covers the delivery of the primary infrastructure works supporting the Rayana community, including earthworks, roads, utility networks and access infrastructure across the development. Located within Wadi Safar, one of the most exclusive districts of Diriyah, Rayana has been carefully designed as a low-density residential enclave that prioritises privacy, space and a seamless connection with the surrounding natural landscape. The infrastructure works will establish the foundations for the community's luxury residential offering, including Rayana Mansions and the branded Trump Mansions. title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
text: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future 16/06/2026 Saudi Arabia Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, is marking its fifth anniversary following a period of rapid international expansion that has transformed the company into a USD 23 billion global real estate platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities. Since launching its first project in Dubai in 2021, DarGlobal has expanded across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the United Kingdom, establishing a diversified portfolio of luxury residential, hospitality and lifestyle destinations. The milestone follows a transformational year for the company.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
text: The milestone follows a transformational year for the company. In FY2025, DarGlobal tripled its Gross Development Value from USD 7.5 billion in FY2024 to USD 23 billion, reflecting the scale and quality of the pipeline it has built across global markets, including five major master-planned communities and a growing portfolio of globally recognised branded residences. Revenue increased by 124% to USD 539 million, while EBITDA reached a record USD 126 million, reflecting strong operational performance and sustained demand across its international portfolio. Today, the company has approximately 6,100 units under construction across 16 projects and maintains a strong financial position, supported by USD 702 million in cash and cash equivalents as of December 2025, alongside a recently secured USD 250 million financing facility to support future growth. Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
text: Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries. What began as a luxury real estate developer has evolved into a diversified platform spanning real estate, hospitality, golf, private clubs, asset management and emerging real estate technologies, developed alongside some of the world's most recognised brands. As we look ahead, our ambition is not simply to build homes, but to create destinations, experiences and ecosystems that define the future of luxury living." As part of its next phase of growth, DarGlobal has expanded into hospitality and entertainment, with luxury hotels under development in Dubai, Riyadh and Muscat. The company is also building a portfolio of golf destinations and private members' clubs across key international markets.

title: DarGlobal Marks Five Years of Global Expansion with $23 Billion Real Estate Portfolio
text: The company is also building a portfolio of golf destinations and private members' clubs across key international markets. In parallel, DarGlobal has launched DarGlobal Capital Partners, its asset management platform, while advancing initiatives in real estate tokenization as part of its strategy to participate in the future evolution of global real estate investment. Another defining element of the company's growth has been its partnerships with some of the world's most recognised luxury brands, including The Trump Organization, Automobili Lamborghini, Aston Martin, Pagani, FENDI, ELIE SAAB, Missoni, Mouawad, Marriott Residences, W Hotels and Nickelodeon Hotels and Resorts. The company recently became the first GCC-based business to be upgraded to the ESCC category of the London Stock Exchange, reflecting its commitment to international governance standards and transparency.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman 24/03/2022 DUBAI, UAE Project marks DarGlobal’s entry into the growing Omani market AIDA is an ode to the glorious Sea of Oman and undisturbed nature, where high curvaceous cliffs flawlessly meet deep waters _______________________ Dubai, UAE; March 24, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040. The value of the investment in the project from both parties will reach SR6 billion, and it will be developed in three stages on an area of 3.5 million square metres. Through the partnership, DarGlobal will develop a mixed-use project in Yiti and Yankat areas, 20-minutes from Downtown Muscat, a paradise with a distinctive terrain where the earthy atmosphere envelops as part of a large master development, situated 100m above the shores and overlooking of the Sea of Oman in Muscat, comprising of 3,500 residential units of medium-sized villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments. A place where two charming hotels of 450 rooms, a plaza filled with cafes and restaurants, a gated promenade with luxury retail and other amenities. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said , “We are excited to become part of this unique project”.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
text: Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said , “We are excited to become part of this unique project”. Our project in Oman builds on DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of elevating the standards and quality of the real-estate sector in the region. But most importantly, with this project, we’re working to ensure a sustainable and environmentally friendly approach to building a large, mixed-use development that fits in with the characteristics of the area. Overlooking one of the most breathtaking horizons in the world will lie a place bubbling with inspiration.” Hashil Bin Obaid Al Mahrouqi, CEO of OMRAN Group, said: “We are delighted to work with DarGlobal on this master project that is being developed with world class expertise.

title: DAR Al Arkan Reveals W Residences Dubai Downtown
text: DAR Al Arkan Reveals W Residences Dubai Downtown DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain 25/02/2022 DUBAI, UAE Worth 1 billion AED, The W Residences Dubai – Downtown brings elegant, prominently positioned homes with access to luxury amenities Residents can step into the heart of the action, and back into their private world at the W Residences Dubai – Downtown Limited number of 384 exclusive units with stunning views of Downtown Dubai _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; February 25, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. The 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand.

title: DAR Al Arkan Reveals W Residences Dubai Downtown

The tower is in close proximity to the many premium and world-famous lifestyle destinations that the city has to offer. Construction of The W Residences Dubai – Downtown is currently underway and is estimated to be completed by December 2025.

title: https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-al-arkan-opens-office-in-china-in-a-bid-to-usher-in-global-growth
text: DarGlobal opens office in China in a bid to usher in global growth 05/02/2022 DUBAI, UAE Riyadh, KSA; February 5, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, continues its dynamic growth momentum by announcing the opening of its office in Beijing, China. The announcement is in line with the DarGlobal’s strategic expansion and builds on spreading the leading Saudi Arabian brands globally. DarGlobal’s Beijing office will serve multiple functions to allow for joint ventures between DarGlobal and leading Chinese real estate developers for the Chinese and the Saudi market, further increasing and facilitate collaboration between Saudi Arabia and China and enhance investment and knowledge sharing opportunities. The office will primarily promote cooperation and partnerships within the real-estate and technology sectors to exchange and implement global best practices in these respective industries. DarGlobal recently appointed Guo Jiancheng as General Manager for DarGlobal’s office in Beijing to lead the company’s operations in China.

title: https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-al-arkan-opens-office-in-china-in-a-bid-to-usher-in-global-growth
text: DarGlobal recently appointed Guo Jiancheng as General Manager for DarGlobal’s office in Beijing to lead the company’s operations in China. Following the announcement Jiancheng commented: “Over its 27-year history in Saudi Arabia DarGlobal has pioneered a distinctive approach to development, introduced new technologies, and raised the benchmark for the real-estate and technology sectors in the Kingdom. With this expertise and industry know-how, the company is well-positioned to take this knowledge and creativity to a global level and promote it as best practice. By entering into the Chinese market, DarGlobal is also well positioned to enhance relations between the Kingdom and China across multiple fronts.” DarGlobal’s office will act as a hub to support Chinese companies and investors seeking expansion, company formation and investment opportunities in the Kingdom. By providing access to required information, permits, legal and financial knowledge, as well as support on partnerships and other requirements, DarGlobal is making entry into the Kingdom more accessible.

text: DarGlobal teams with Pagani Automobili to unveil an ultra-exclusive residential tower in Dubai 15/12/2021 DUBAI, UAE A tower whose interior design reflects the uniqueness and distinctive features of Pagani’s DNA, boldly taking its place among the most famous towers in the world in the heart of Downtown Dubai Overlooking the world’s largest building Burj Khalifa, the AED 800 million tower is an exclusive and radically designed masterpiece. _______________________ Dubai, UAE; December 15, 2021: DarGlobal , the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, has unveiled the DarGlobal Pagani Tower in Dubai in partnership with Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, renowned for its exclusive and handcrafted production of ultra-limited-edition cars.

title: https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-al-arkan-teams-with-pagani-automobili-to-unveil-an-ultra-exclusive-residential-tower-in-dubai
text: _______________________ Dubai, UAE; December 15, 2021: DarGlobal , the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, has unveiled the DarGlobal Pagani Tower in Dubai in partnership with Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, renowned for its exclusive and handcrafted production of ultra-limited-edition cars. The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks significant milestones for both the companies: DarGlobal’s continued regional expansion by partnering with the world’s top luxury brands, and the world’s first ever Pagani-inspired exclusive spaces being launched along with the bespoke line of interior furniture, branded Pagani. The tower offers spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the building a true sculpted heaven within the bustling city.

text: DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai 06/12/2021 DUBAI, UAE Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns. title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
text: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal Five Types of Insurance Coverage Every Homeowner Needs Owning a home is a significant achievement and a substantial investment that necessitates protection. As a homeowner, it’s crucial to understand the various types of insurance coverage available to safeguard your property and finances. Here are five essential types of insurance coverage every homeowner should consider: 1. Homeowners Insurance This is the most fundamental and necessary form of insurance for homeowners. It covers the structure of your home, your personal belongings, and liability protection in case someone is injured on your property. Homeowners insurance typically covers damage from fires, storms, theft, and other common hazards. However, it’s important to read the fine print, as certain natural disasters like floods and earthquakes are often not covered. 2. Flood Insurance Standard homeowners insurance policies do not cover flood damage. If your home is in a flood-prone area, flood insurance is indispensable.

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
text: If your home is in a flood-prone area, flood insurance is indispensable. This insurance covers damage to your home’s structure and belongings due to flooding. The National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and private insurers provide this coverage, which can be a lifesaver in safeguarding your investment against unpredictable natural disasters. 3. Earthquake Insurance Similar to flood insurance, earthquake insurance is a must-have if you live in an area prone to earthquakes. This coverage helps repair or rebuild your home and replace personal belongings in the event of an earthquake. Considering the devastating impact an earthquake can have, this insurance provides essential financial protection. 4. Umbrella Liability Insurance Umbrella liability insurance provides additional liability coverage beyond what your standard homeowners insurance offers. It protects your assets and future earnings in case you’re sued for damages that exceed the liability limits of your other insurance policies.

title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal
text: It protects your assets and future earnings in case you’re sued for damages that exceed the liability limits of your other insurance policies. It’s particularly valuable for homeowners with significant assets or potential exposure to liability claims. 5. Home Warranty or Home Repair Insurance While not traditional insurance, a home warranty or home repair insurance can be a wise investment. This coverage typically pays for the repair or replacement of major home systems and appliances that break down over time. It’s a practical way to manage unexpected repair costs and ensure that your home remains in good working order. In summary, while homeownership is a source of pride, it also comes with risks. By investing in the right insurance coverages, you can protect your home, belongings, and financial well-being against unforeseen events. title: Dubai Real Estate ROI in 2025: Rental Yields vs. Capital Appreciation
text: In real estate, it helps investors understand how much profit they’ve made, or can expect to make, relative to the cost of the property. Basic ROI Formula: ROI = (Net Profit/Total Investment Cost)×100 Net Profit = Total rental income or resale value – All expenses (maintenance, taxes, mortgage, etc.) Total Investment Cost = Purchase price + Additional costs (closing fees, renovation, etc.) This formula provides a percentage that indicates the return you’re earning for every dirham invested. title: Freehold vs Leasehold in Dubai: Key Differences

Freehold refers to full property ownership, whereas leasehold grants usage rights for a term of 30 to 99 years. Freehold owners enjoy complete control, can modify properties freely, and pass them on to heirs automatically. Leasehold owners face usage restrictions, require approvals for changes, and the property reverts to the landlord after the lease ends. Freehold buyers cover all maintenance costs, while leasehold owners rely on landlords for significant repairs. title: Freehold vs Leasehold in Dubai: Key Differences
text: DarGlobal’s luxury freehold developments combine ownership security with premium locations and strong investment potential. What Is A Freehold Property In Dubai? Freehold property is where you own the land and the property. When you purchase the property, you own it for life. You can sell it, rent it, build upon it (with permissions), or pass it down to your heirs. Dubai opened its doors to foreign investors purchasing freehold properties in 2002, and with real estate developers like DarGlobal, the appeal of freehold properties in Dubai is growing stronger. Its properties, like DG1 Living and Trump International Hotel & Tower, are the epitome of freehold investments for long-term growth and high returns. What Is A Leasehold Property In Dubai? A leasehold property entitles you to occupy a property for a specified number of years, typically ranging from 30 to 99. However, you do not own the property, as the real estate developer or the landowner still retains ownership. When the lease expires, the property will go back to the original owner unless it is renewed.

title: Freehold vs Leasehold in Dubai: Key Differences
text: When the lease expires, the property will go back to the original owner unless it is renewed. Key Differences Between Leasehold And Freehold Properties Now that we know what freehold and leasehold are, let us explore the differences between freehold and leasehold properties. Freehold grants complete title ownership of a property and land, while Leasehold offers a right to use the property for a limited period (typically 30–99 years). Freehold properties are typically located in specific areas accessible to foreigners, whereas leasehold properties are available in a broader range of places. Freehold owners have complete control of the property (subject to certain conditions), whereas leasehold owners require permission from the landlord to make modifications. Successors can inherit freehold ownership, but leasehold ownership automatically reverts to the landlord upon expiration of the lease. In freehold properties, maintenance is entirely in the hands of the owners, while in leasehold properties, major maintenance is in the hands of the landlord.

title: Freehold vs Leasehold in Dubai: Key Differences
text: In freehold properties, maintenance is entirely in the hands of the owners, while in leasehold properties, major maintenance is in the hands of the landlord. Freehold property is usually more expensive to purchase initially, while leasehold property is generally cheaper to start with. The resale of freehold properties is not subject to restrictions, whereas the resale of leasehold properties can be conditional. Freehold properties offer the opportunity for a renewable UAE residence visa when the property is valued at over AED 1 million, whereas leasehold properties are not eligible for a visa. title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
text: Let us explore the real estate cycle and how it can help you make smart investment decisions. Key Takeaways A real estate cycle refers to recurring phases of expansion and contraction, associated with real estate values. Real estate cycles follow a very predictable pattern based on supply, demand, and changing prices. The real estate cycle consists of four stages: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, and Recession, which are used to determine when to buy, hold, or sell property. Every phase of the housing cycle affects investment decisions depending on market performance and timing. Real estate assets undergo the cycle of purchase, construction, operation, and sale. Investors can track economic and market indicators to inform their investment choices at each stage. What Is The Real Estate Cycle? A real estate cycle refers to the recurring phases of expansion and contraction associated with real estate values, driven by economic, social, and political conditions. It undergoes various phases, including recovery, expansion, hyper supply, and recession.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
text: It undergoes various phases, including recovery, expansion, hyper supply, and recession. Thus, understanding this cycle helps investors make informed decisions about when to invest or withdraw from the market, as they comprehend the supply and demand dynamics of the market. Consequently, the cycle is used to forecast periods when property values appreciate or depreciate. It also aids in estimating rental yields and determining when to buy or sell for a profit. Phases Of The Real Estate Cycle Explained The real estate cycle typically goes through four phases: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, and Recession. Each of these stages has its own indicators that tell you how the market is behaving. Recovery This is where the market is beginning to gain momentum after slowing down. Demand is slowly rising, but everyone still believes the market is in recession. There is little or no construction, high vacancy, and negative growth in rents. It's a silent turning point, difficult to observe but full of promise for early buyers. Expansion This is the positive phase.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
text: Expansion This is the positive phase. The economy is on the upswing, individuals find employment, and housing demand is higher. Occupancy levels increase, rents escalate, and developers start constructing new developments. Property prices also increase during this phase. It's largely the best time to invest in or acquire properties. Hyper Supply Optimism causes overbuilding. There are simply too many new buildings that are entering the market, and demand lags behind supply. Prices then decelerate, vacancy rises, and rental growth falters. Investors must be cautious here and concentrate on maintaining existing assets. Recession Here, the prices fall, demand dries up, and houses sit empty. It may sound ghastly, but it can be the best time to find undervalued houses if you're ready financially. How The Housing Market Cycle Affects Investment Decisions? Each stage of the housing market cycle has an impact on your investment decision. Let’s have a look at it: In the recovery stage, one should buy properties at depressed prices and hold them until they appreciate.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
text: Let’s have a look at it: In the recovery stage, one should buy properties at depressed prices and hold them until they appreciate. Conversely, in the expansion stage, investors need to invest in high-demand locations with high rental yields. However, during the phase of hyper-supply, you should retain your investments and refrain from making new or risky purchases. Therefore, focus on retaining tenants and optimizing property returns. But when the housing market is facing recession, you should be wise enough to sell disappointing assets and retain cash until favorable times return. However, many experienced investors also prefer buying property during this time at lower prices. Understanding The Life Cycle Of Real Estate Assets A real estate asset lifecycle begins at the planning phase, proceeds through maintenance, and culminates in its disposal. It encompasses four primary stages: Planning, Acquisition, Operation, and Disposal. Each stage has a set of activities and goals for both the developer and the investor.

title: Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
text: Each stage has a set of activities and goals for both the developer and the investor. Planning Stage Here investors identify an opportunity, assess its value, obtain the funds, and finalize the purchase. Acquisition Stage The building or remodeling is done to prepare the property for renting. It involves permits and managing the project from start to finish. Operation Stage In this stage the cash flows are derived and can take many years as property owners deal with tenants, collect rent, manage maintenance, and perform day-to-day operations. Disposal Stage Now, you can sell your property to a new owner. Therefore, it’s time to find a buyer, prepare the property for sale, and finalize the sale. Real Estate Market Cycle: Indicators To Watch Monitoring the real estate cycle involves tracking the correct indicators. Economic indicators, such as employment growth and GDP, drive real estate demand. The higher people's incomes, the more they purchase or lease homes. Interest rates are also a crucial factor; low rates stimulate buying, while high rates slow the market's pace.

During this period, you can secure low-interest loans and be patient until property prices appreciate. Step 2: Expansion - Increase Income And Value When the economy begins to recover and expand, consider increasing rents, improving property conditions, and enhancing operational efficiency. Reinvest in prime locations to build equity. Step 3: Hyper Supply – Focus On Stability, And Exit At Highs When oversupply is entering the marketplace and demand is softening, reduce exposure. Sell high-performing assets at peak prices, or refinance properties to raise money. Maintain quality properties, and reputable tenants. Step 4: Recession – Defend Capital And Buy At A Discount Avoid over-leveraging and protect your income-generating investments.

text: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide Do You Pay Council Tax On An Empty Property: 2025 Rules, Exemptions, And Charges Explained Having an empty property comes with its expenses and liabilities. One of them is the council tax, which is charged on the majority of residential properties. So, even if your property is empty, you might still be charged for it. In 2025, the council tax on empty homes will be made more specific, with different prices depending on the length of the property's vacancy. That is why investors and property owners need to be aware of these rules to plan their finances better and avoid paying unnecessary penalties. Thus, in this DarGlobal guide, we will explain how council tax is charged to empty properties, available exemptions, the empty property premium, and ways to reduce it legally. title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
text: Council tax is payable on empty homes, with the tax depending on size, category, and council policy. There are a few misunderstandings that can confuse, such as that probate properties are always excluded. Certain empty properties are exempt, including those in probate or exceptional circumstances. Keeping the property unoccupied for too long may lead to an empty property premium, the costs of which escalate over time. There are certain legal ways of evading council tax payment, such as letting property or guardianship. Do You Pay Council Tax on an Empty Property in 2025? Yes, you will be required to pay council tax even if you are not living in your home. The amount of discount varies with the location. However, some councils offer no discount at all. Also, if your house has been empty for a year or more, you will be charged an additional premium called the empty home premium. The longer the house has not been used, the more this premium can be. For example, a house empty for ten or more years can be charged four times the basic council tax.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
text: For example, a house empty for ten or more years can be charged four times the basic council tax. Do You Pay Council Tax on Empty Property: Common Misconceptions? Most homeowners believe that when a home is empty, council tax is not due. This is not necessarily the case in most situations. Council tax is based on the property type and value, not occupancy. Another frequent misconception is that all inherited property automatically becomes exempt from council tax. Although there can be interim exemptions upon the issue of probate, these do not apply indefinitely . Council Tax Exemptions for Empty Properties Some empty properties are completely exempt from council tax. The exemptions apply in some cases and are most commonly related to the condition of the property or the property's owner. If the property owner is in prison, living in a hospital, or a care home for long-term care, the property is exempt. Repossessed houses, houses that are legally uninhabitable, or houses subject to compulsory purchase, become exempt.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
text: Repossessed houses, houses that are legally uninhabitable, or houses subject to compulsory purchase, become exempt. If the owner is deceased, council tax is not due until probate is granted, provided the property is unoccupied. Exceptionally, a further six months' exemption may be granted while the property is unoccupied and in the name of the deceased. Another situation when you will not have to pay this premium is if the property is an annexe, or you are in the military and need to live in accommodation provided. You can also avoid the premium for up to 12 months if the property has recently been inherited through probate, is on sale or for letting, or is being thoroughly renovated or undergoing structural work. Empty Property Premium: What Happens If a Property Is Left Vacant Too Long? The empty homes premium is an added charge on basic council tax for homes that are unfurnished and vacant for extended periods. The amount increases the longer they have been vacant, to encourage owners to refurbish and occupy premises.

title: Do You Pay Council Tax On Empty Property? 2025 Rules Guide
text: The amount increases the longer they have been vacant, to encourage owners to refurbish and occupy premises. If a property has been kept vacant for over two years, the premium can be 100% of the usual bill. It can be 200% after five years and 300% after ten years. Hence, keeping a property vacant for a long period of time can actually be very costly. How to Avoid Paying Council Tax on an Empty Property (Legally) There are legally permissible ways of reducing or phasing out the council tax payment on an empty property. You can legally avoid paying the council tax in a few situations, like: If you are undertaking major renovation work, or the owner is in long-term care. If you rent out the property. It will transfer the council tax responsibility to the tenants. If you appoint a property guardian who can keep the property occupied without the need to enter long-term tenancies. Gifts during your lifetime can also lower the taxable value of your estate . How Much Is Capital Gains Tax on Property in 2025? Capital gain tax should be paid on the profit made when you sell a property. The profit is calculated by subtracting the cost price and allowable expenses from the selling price. Allowable expenses include legal costs, additions, and certain professional fees. Once your gain is calculated, tax allowances and reliefs payable each year are added to determine how much tax is payable. The rate is determined by your tax band and the type of property disposed of. How to Work Out Capital Gains Tax on Property?

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap How Rail Is Reshaping the Region Into One Connected Market of Opportunity In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day. After 13:15, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M — an extraordinary leap in one generation. But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC. The Trains Are Coming One rail announcement after another is transforming six separate markets into one connected region: - Riyadh–Doha high-speed rail ~2 hours of travel, 10M+ passengers expected, 30K new jobs, ~$30B in economic impact. - UAE domestic rail (Etihad Rail) Linking 11 cities as of 2026.

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text: - UAE domestic rail (Etihad Rail) Linking 11 cities as of 2026. Abu Dhabi to Dubai in 57 minutes, with a future high-speed train cutting that to 30 minutes. - UAE–Oman corridor (Hafeet Rail) Connecting Abu Dhabi to Sohar in ~100 minutes, transforming both passenger movement and freight. All of this feeds into the 2,100 km GCC Railway, which by 2030 aims to create a single passenger experience that feels like domestic travel. What This Means for People & Business When borders become this frictionless, behavior changes. Millions of air passengers now have tempting alternatives. Tourism spreads - Dubai residents can finish work on Friday and enjoy dinner in Muscat. - Families in Doha see Riyadh as a two-hour weekend trip. - Standalone trips evolve into multi-city Gulf experiences. Business accelerates - Morning meetings in Riyadh, back in Abu Dhabi by afternoon. - Supply chains reorganize around rail hubs. - Companies hire across the GCC as commuting replaces relocation. At this scale, mobility turns the GCC into one integrated economic system — because practically, it becomes one.

title: Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable?
text: Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable? Few asset classes hold the prestige, financial resilience, and emotional appeal of a waterfront luxury property . Whether situated along iconic coastlines, serene lakeshores, or private island enclaves, prime waterfront real estate consistently commands the highest valuations in global real estate. Understanding the unique forces behind these market dynamics explains why buyers continue to pay premium prices for coastal real estate. 1. Scarcity and Finite Coastline Supply The primary factor driving the value of a waterfront luxury property is fundamental economics: supply is strictly finite. Developers can construct additional urban towers or extend suburban communities, but oceanfront and lakefront shorelines cannot be expanded. Because coastal land availability remains permanently capped, inventory stays limited.

title: Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable?

This significant price premium is driven by three key fundamentals: geographic scarcity , as the supply of prime shoreline plots remains permanently fixed; exceptional rental yields , supported by constant demand from luxury travelers for both short- and long-term stays; and unmatched market resilience , allowing shoreline developments to rebound faster than inland sectors following economic shifts. title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property. Understanding how to balance long-term appreciation with immediate cash generation allows investors to optimize their total returns while managing risk across market cycles. Defining Capital Growth and Rental Yield To construct an effective portfolio strategy, it is necessary to first separate how these two metrics generate financial value. Capital Growth refers to the increase in a property’s market value over time. It represents the equity built between the original purchase price and the appreciated market value.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: It represents the equity built between the original purchase price and the appreciated market value. In luxury real estate, capital appreciation is typically driven by geographic scarcity, architectural prestige, prime locations, and long-term infrastructure developments. Rental Yield measures the annual income generated by a property as a percentage of its total purchase price or current market value. Gross yield calculates total annual rent against property price, whereas net yield factors in holding costs such as service fees, property management, insurance, and maintenance. The Dynamics of Luxury Real Estate Returns In standard residential housing, investors can often find properties that offer high rental yields. However, the luxury real estate sector operates under unique market dynamics where capital appreciation and yield often move in opposite directions. The Capital Growth Advantage in Prime Markets Luxury properties in world-class metropolitan hubs and exclusive coastal resorts are engineered primarily for capital appreciation.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: The Capital Growth Advantage in Prime Markets Luxury properties in world-class metropolitan hubs and exclusive coastal resorts are engineered primarily for capital appreciation. Ultra-high-net-worth buyers purchase these homes for their status, architectural uniqueness, and prime addresses—factors that remain permanently scarce. Asset Preservation: High-end homes act as strong capital preservation vehicles during inflationary periods. Equity Leverage: Substantial equity growth allows investors to borrow against accumulated value to acquire additional real estate assets. Compounding Value: Over an extended holding period, a modest annual appreciation percentage on a multi-million-dollar property translates to massive absolute financial gains. Because purchase prices for luxury estates are exceptionally high, the corresponding rental yield percentage often appears lower compared to entry-level housing. Investors who prioritize capital growth accept lower short-term rental yields in exchange for substantial wealth accumulation at resale.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: Investors who prioritize capital growth accept lower short-term rental yields in exchange for substantial wealth accumulation at resale. The Role of Rental Yield in Luxury Assets While luxury properties typically deliver lower yield percentages (often ranging between 3% and 5% net), the absolute cash flow generated in nominal currency remains significant due to high rental rates. Cash Flow Stability: Steady rental income helps cover ongoing holding costs, HOA fees, property taxes, and maintenance expenses. Risk Mitigation: Positive yields provide a financial buffer during broader economic downturns or periods when capital appreciation slows. Short-Term Luxury Rentals: Premium beachfront villas and branded residences often achieve higher yield figures by tapping into the high-end short-term vacation market.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: Short-Term Luxury Rentals: Premium beachfront villas and branded residences often achieve higher yield figures by tapping into the high-end short-term vacation market. Evaluating Capital Growth vs Rental Yield To understand which focus aligns best with your portfolio, it helps to examine how each approach functions across key metrics: Primary Objective: Capital growth focuses on long-term equity accumulation, whereas rental yield focuses on immediate operational cash flow. Holding Horizon: Growth-oriented assets deliver their highest overall returns over medium to long timeframes (7 to 10+ years). Yield-focused assets provide immediate monthly liquidity. Market Dynamics: Capital growth is heavily concentrated in prime urban centers and exclusive waterfront enclaves. Yield opportunities are frequently found in emerging districts, commercial luxury spaces, or high-density holiday destinations. Management Requirements: High-yield luxury assets—especially short-term rentals—demand active management, frequent upkeep, and tenant sourcing.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: Management Requirements: High-yield luxury assets—especially short-term rentals—demand active management, frequent upkeep, and tenant sourcing. Prime buy-and-hold residential estates require less operational oversight. Selecting the Right Strategy for Your Portfolio Choosing between a growth-focused strategy and a yield-focused strategy depends on your financial timeline, risk tolerance, and liquidity requirements. When to Prioritize Capital Growth A capital-growth-centric strategy is ideal if your primary goal is long-term generational wealth creation. Investors with strong outside liquidity can easily absorb ongoing maintenance costs and hold prime assets through market fluctuations. If you are investing in established blue-chip locations with fixed land supply, focusing on long-term value appreciation will generally yield superior long-term results. When to Prioritize Rental Yield A yield-centric strategy suits investors who require steady liquidity to service leverage or cover ongoing lifestyle expenses.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: When to Prioritize Rental Yield A yield-centric strategy suits investors who require steady liquidity to service leverage or cover ongoing lifestyle expenses. If you are looking to create a self-sustaining real estate portfolio where rental income pays off development debts, prioritizing higher yields ensures your assets carry themselves without requiring ongoing cash infusions. Achieving a Balanced Hybrid Approach The most sophisticated real estate portfolios do not treat capital growth vs rental yield as an either-or choice. Instead, experienced investors blend both approaches to maximize total returns . Strategic Location Pairing: Hold trophy properties in established prime locations for long-term equity growth, complemented by modern luxury apartments in high-demand business districts for higher rental yields. Off-Plan Property Acquisitions: Purchasing high-end off-plan units at early launch prices allows investors to capture capital growth during the construction phase, followed by immediate rental yield once the building is completed.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
text: Off-Plan Property Acquisitions: Purchasing high-end off-plan units at early launch prices allows investors to capture capital growth during the construction phase, followed by immediate rental yield once the building is completed. Value-Add Renovations: Acquiring older luxury properties in prime addresses and modernizing them can simultaneously boost the asset's overall market valuation and command higher ongoing rental rates. While this percentage is lower than entry-level housing, the high purchase price translates to substantial absolute cash income. 2. Why do luxury properties often have lower rental yields than standard properties? Luxury property prices appreciate at a rate that outpaces proportional rent increases. Because buyers pay a premium for status, views, and exclusive locations, the purchase price increases faster than the rental rate tenants are willing to pay. 3.

title: Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate

Luxury assets carry higher holding expenses, including luxury HOA fees, concierge services, specialized insurance, and premium property maintenance. What did Missoni design at Marea?

title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni | Costa Del Sol, Spain
text: What did Missoni design at Marea? Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout the residences, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature approach to colour, pattern, and material quality into kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The brand-led interiors give each residence a distinctive identity beyond standard luxury specification. What unit types and sizes are available at Marea? Marea offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm. When will Marea, Interiors by Missoni be completed? Phase 1 of Marea completed in 2024. The full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni | Costa Del Sol, Spain
text: Marea sits within the Finca Cortesin gated estate in Cortesin, Costa Del Sol. The beach is 5 minutes away, Marbella is 20 minutes, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are a 20-minute drive, Santa Maria Polo Club is 15 minutes, Gibraltar Airport is 45 minutes, and Malaga Airport is 50 minutes. What is the 270-degree view at Marea? The site's elevation and orientation give residences an unobstructed 270-degree panorama that stretches from Marbella along the Costa Del Sol coastline, across to Gibraltar, and continues to the mountains of Morocco on the African continent, with the Mediterranean Sea and Finca Cortesin golf course directly below. What amenities does Marea, Interiors by Missoni offer? Amenities include a gated community with private entrance and 24/7 premium security, 24-hour concierge, infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, hanging observation deck, community garden, children's playground, children's swimming pool, children's splash area, and dedicated parking and storage per unit. text: فلل للبيع الرياض .. قارن بالصور والأسعار يكثر المعروض من فلل للبيع في الرياض ب 800 الف وغيرها من أسعار تختلف باختلاف مساحة الفيلا، ولكن للحصول على الاختيار الصحيح، وكذلك المفاضلة المبينة على توفير المعلومات عن كل فيلا؛ فإن منصة وصلت سوف تساعدك في الاطلاع على كل المعروض في كل حي من فلل للبيع في الرياض والاختيار من بينها بسهولة، وسوف نزودك فيما يلي بمتوسط أسعار بعض الفلل المعروضة على الموقع: يبدأ متوسط سعر فلل للبيع حي اليرموك الرياض من 5,903 ريال سعودي للمتر المربع لفيلا بمساحة 225 متر مربع على شارع بعرض 15م، أما سعر الفيلا الإجمالي 4,250,000 ريال، ومع اختلاف مساحات الفلل في حي اليرموك إلا أن متوسط السعر متقارب إلى حد كبير، حيث يصل سعر فيلا بمساحة 720 متر مربع مع شقتين واجهة شمالية نحو 5,903 ريال للمتر المربع وإجمالي سعر الفيلا 4,250,000 ريال. كما يتميز متوسط سعر بيوت للبيع حي الرمال الرياض بالتنوع والتلاؤم مع شرائح مختلفة، حيث يبلغ إجمالي سعر فيلا بمساحة 320 متر مربع نحو 1,150,000 ريال، و3,594 ريال للمتر المربع، ويصل سعر فيلا بمساحة 910 متر مربع على شارع بعرض 30 م نحو 4,176 ريال للمتر المربع، وإجمال سعر الفيلا 3,800,000 ريال سعودي.

title: فلل للبيع في الخبر | موقع وصلت
text: فلل للبيع الخبر: سكن عصري في مجتمع راقي بفضل ازدهارها تجاريًا وصناعيًا وسياحيًا، تعتبر مدينة الخبر من أغلى وأفضل المدن السعودية من حيث المعيشة. لذلك، تفوقت فلل للبيع بالخبر على فلل للبيع بريدة وغيرها من عقارات مدن المملكة الأخرى مثل الرياض وجدة، وكذلك عقار ابها وذلك من حيث الرقي والعصرية والفرص الاستثمارية الرائدة. بحسب مؤشر تكلفة المعيشة الذي تصدره قاعدة Numdeo العالمية للبيانات، جاءت مدينة الخبر كأغلى مدينة في تكاليف المعيشة وهو ما يشير إلى رقي مجتمعها وفخامة السكن بها. إلى جانب اكتشاف النفط بها، وموقعها على ساحل الخليج العربي، تعتبر مدينة الخبر من أكثر المدن السعودية نظامًا وترتيبًا. أضف إلى ذلك أنه في عام 2024، تم إدراج مدينة الخبر ضمن مؤشر المدن الذكية الخاص بالمعهد الدولي للتنمية الإدارية IMD كمدينة ذكية لتصبح بذلك خامس مدينة ذكية في السعودية بعد الرياض ومكة والمدينة وجدة. فضلًا عن اعتماد مدينة الخبر من قبل منظمة الصحة العالمية كمدينة صحية بعدما حققت 80 معيارًا عالميًا من معايير المدن الصحية.

title: شقق للايجار في حي الخليج الرياض | موقع وصلت
text: أهم المرافق التي تقع بجوار شقق للايجار حي الخليج الرياض يتميّز حي الخليج بتوفّر جميع المرافق الخدمية والترفيهية التي تلبي احتياجات السكان من مختلف الفئات العمرية، مما يجعله بيئة مثالية للعيش. وتشمل هذه المرافق: المراكز التعليمية : مثل مدارس الفلاح الأهلية للبنات ومدارس منارات الخليج العالمية، والتي توفّر بيئة تعليمية متطورة بمناهج متنوعة. المراكز الصحية : من أبرزها مجمع بليسان الرياض الطبي ومجمع ديار الرعاية الطبي، اللذان يقدّمان خدمات طبية على مدار الساعة. الأسواق التجارية : مثل أسواق عبدالله العثيم ومتجر زاوية العنود، حيث يمكن للسكان شراء كافة مستلزماتهم اليومية. الحدائق والمرافق الترفيهية : منها حديقة الخليج الهادئة، ومركز بادل الرياض الذي يوفّر نشاطات رياضية مميزة. المساجد والجوامع : من أبرزها جامع الأمير محمد بن عبدالعزيز ومسجد لطيفة، وتخدم جميع سكان الحي في مختلف الاتجاهات. المطاعم والمقاهي : يقدم الحي تشكيلة متنوعة من المطاعم والمقاهي، مثل فوال الإخلاص، مطعم كنتاكي، ومقهى سفينة الخليج، لتلبية مختلف الأذواق. مميزات استئجار شقة بدلًا من التملك في حي الخليج المرونة العالية إذ أن استئجار الشقة لا يتطلب التزامات مالية كبرى أو طويلة المدى.

title: شقق للايجار في حي الخليج الرياض | موقع وصلت
text: مميزات استئجار شقة بدلًا من التملك في حي الخليج المرونة العالية إذ أن استئجار الشقة لا يتطلب التزامات مالية كبرى أو طويلة المدى. سهولة التغيير والانتقال وفقًا لظروفك الخاصة. الراحة من أعمال الصيانة إذ أنها غالبًا ما تقع مسؤوليتها على المالك. توفر خيارات قصيرة الأمد مثل شقق للايجار اليومي في الرياض ، وهي مثالية للزوار أو التجربة قبل الاستقرار. أفضل المواسم للبحث عن شقق للايجار الخليج الرياض رغم أن هناك الكثير من الوحدات السكنية المتاحة للإيجار داخل الحي على مدار العام، إلا أن هناك بعض المواسم التي يفضل البحث خلالها لضمان الحصول على مسكن مثالي بسعر تنافسي، ومنها: ما قبل بداية العام الدراسي في الفترة بين شهري أغسطس وسبتمبر بسبب انتقال العائلات ما يتيح الكثير من الخيارات. موسم الشتاء إذ غالبًا ما تنخفض أسعار الشقق لقلة الطلب. بعد موسم الحج حيث يعود السوق لحيويته وتتوفر وحدات عديدة. منتصف كل ربع سنة حيث يقدم الملاك خصومات لسرعة التأجير. هل هناك عيوب في شقق حي الخليج؟ تعرّف على التحديات وحلولها ارتفاع أسعار بعض الشقق السكنية خاصة المفروشة أو القريبة من الطرق الحيوية. الطلب المرتفع على الشقق مما يعيق العثور على وحدة مناسبة بسعر مقبول.

title: فلل للبيع في الخبر | موقع وصلت

title: شقق للايجار في مكة | موقع وصلت
text: أضف إلى ذلك أن أسعار شقق للايجار بمكة تفاوتت بشكل يتناسب مع مختلف الميزانيات، كما أنها تتسم بفوارق سعرية ملحوظة بين الشقق التي تقع في الأحياء المجاورة للحرم المكي والأحياء البعيدة عنه. يمكننا التعرف على متوسط أسعار شقق للايجار مكه من خلال ما يقدمه موقع وصلت من نماذج موثوق بها كالتالي: متوسط أسعار شقة للايجار في مكة حي العزيزية مساحة 48.85 متر مربع وتتكون من غرفتين 25 ألف ريال سعودي سنويًا. متوسط أسعار شقق للايجار مكة حي الشامية الجديدة مساحة 600 متر مربع وتتكون من 5 غرف 25 ألف ريال سعودي سنويًا. متوسط أسعار شقق للايجار مكه حي الخضراء مساحة 650 متر مربع وتتكون من 5 غرف 36 ألف ريال سعودي سنويًا. متوسط أسعار شقق للايجار بمكة حي الملك فهد مساحة 500 متر مربع وتتكون من 3 غرف 45 ألف ريال سعودي سنويًا. متوسط أسعار شقق للايجار في مكه حي العوالي نصف مفروشة وتتكون من غرفة واحدة 23 ألف ريال سعودي سنويًا. تتميز أسعار شقق للايجار بمكة رخيصة ب 25 ألف ريال بالتنوع الذي يساعد كل مواطن على استئجار منزله المستقبلي بما يناسب ميزانيته.

text: بطحاء قريش، مكة المكرمة 2 جديد واتساب اتصال 1 2 3 4 5 الرئيسية عقار السعودية | شقق للبيع في السعودية عقار مكة| شقق للبيع في مكة شقق للبيع في حي بطحاء قريش بمكة المكرمة شقق للبيع حي بطحاء قريش مكة: تنوع سكني وفرص استثمارية تمنحك شقق للبيع حي بطحاء قريش مكة فرصة مميزة للعيش في واحد من أكثر أحياء المدينة تطورًا وازدهارًا. فهذا الحي يجمع بين القرب من المسجد الحرام والمرافق الحديثة التي تلبي احتياجات العائلات والأفراد على حد سواء. ومع تنوع الخيارات المتاحة من حيث المساحات والأسعار، يُعد بطحاء قريش وجهة مثالية للباحثين في سوق عقارات مكة عن الراحة السكنية أو العائد الاستثماري الآمن. حي بطحاء قريش: موقع استراتيجي فريد يمثل الموقع أحد أهم العوامل التي تزيد من جاذبية شقق للبيع في بطحاء قريش ، حيث يتسم الحي بالمزج بين القرب من مركز مكة المكرمة وسهولة الوصول إلى الطرق الرئيسية. ومن أبرز مميزات الحي المكانية: القرب من المسجد الحرام : يبعد الحي مسافة 20 دقيقة بالسيارة عن الكعبة، مما يجعله خيارًا مثاليًا للراغبين في السكن بالقرب من أطهر بقاع الأرض. الاتصال بشبكة الطرق : يقع في محيط مجموعة من الطرق الرئيسية مثل الطريق الدائري الثالث، ما يسهّل التنقل إلى مختلف أحياء مكة.

title: شقق للبيع في حي بطحاء قريش مكة المكرمة
text: الاتصال بشبكة الطرق : يقع في محيط مجموعة من الطرق الرئيسية مثل الطريق الدائري الثالث، ما يسهّل التنقل إلى مختلف أحياء مكة. الموقع الحيوي : يتوسط الحي العديد من المراكز التجارية والخدمية مثل سوق الكعكية للجملة ومستشفى النور التخصصي، مما يعزز من راحة السكان. القرب من الأحياء الهامة : مثل حي الجامعة وحي الشوقية وحي العوالي، وهي أحياء عصرية تشهد تطورًا عمرانيًا متسارعًا. وإذا أردت توسيع خياراتك، يمكنك تصفح قائمة شقق للبيع مكة عبر موقع وصلت لتجد المزيد من العروض المتنوعة. البنية التحتية والخدمات في حي بطحاء قريش لا يقتصر تميز بطحاء قريش على موقعه فقط، بل يتفوق أيضًا في بنيته التحتية ووفرة الخدمات المتطورة التي تعزز من جودة الحياة والاستثمار به مثل: المدارس : مثل مدرسة الثانية والعشرين المتوسط ومدارس رؤية الغد الأهلية. المراكز الصحية : مثل مركز الرعاية الصحية الأولية ومجمع البشرى الطبي العام. المراكز التجارية : مثل هايبر بندة وأسواق العثيم. المساجد : مثل مسجد الحسن بن علي وجامع التعاون. الطرق والشوارع الرئيسية : مثل شارع عبدالله سعود العيسي وشارع عتاب بن أسيد. المرافق الترفيهية : مثل المطاعم كمطعم قصر الشواية، والمقاهي كسلالة قهوة مختصة، والحدائق كحديقة بطحاء قريش.

title: شقق للبيع في حي بطحاء قريش مكة المكرمة
text: المرافق الترفيهية : مثل المطاعم كمطعم قصر الشواية، والمقاهي كسلالة قهوة مختصة، والحدائق كحديقة بطحاء قريش. أنواع شقق للبيع مكة حي بطحاء قريش يضم هذا الحي مجموعة واسعة من خيارات الشقق المتاحة للبيع مثل: الشقق الصغيرة : تتكون من غرفة إلى غرفتين وصالة، وهي مناسبة للعزاب والأزواج الجدد والأسر الصغيرة التي ترغب في الإقامة بالقرب من الحرم. الشقق المتوسطة : تشمل 3 غرف وصالة وتلائم الأسر المتوسطة التي تبحث عن سكن مريح بسعر مناسب. الشقق الكبيرة : تضم 4 إلى 5 غرف وهي مثالية للعائلات الكبيرة التي تبحث عن مساحات أوسع بأسعار أقل من الفلل. شقق ملحقة بحديقة أو سطح : خيار مناسب لمحبي الخصوصية الكاملة مع مساحات مفتوحة. وإذا كنت تبحث عن المزيد من الخيارات السكنية خارج مكة، استكشف شقق للبيع المدينة التي تُعَد وجهة واعدة للسكن والاستثمار. مميزات شراء شقة للبيع في بطحاء قريش عند التفكير في سوق شقق للبيع حي بطحاء قريش ، تجد نفسك أمام باقة من المميزات التي تشمل: تنوع المساحات : ما يجعلها تناسب فئات المجتمع المختلفة بدءً من الشباب إلى العائلات الممتدة. الأسعار التنافسية : يعتبر الحي فرصة سكنية مميزة بسعر مناسب مقارنة بالأحياء القريبة من الحرم.

title: شقق للبيع في حي بطحاء قريش مكة المكرمة
text: الأسعار التنافسية : يعتبر الحي فرصة سكنية مميزة بسعر مناسب مقارنة بالأحياء القريبة من الحرم. الطابع العصري : معظم شقق للبيع في حي بطحاء قريش حديثة البناء، وهو ما يمنحها تصاميم عصرية تلبي متطلبات السكن الحديث. السكينة والهدوء : رغم قرب الحي من وسط مكة إلا أنه يتميز بالهدوء بعيدًا عن ضوضاء الأحياء التجارية. الفرص الاستثمارية : يُعد شراء الشقق في الحي فرصة ذهبية للاستثمار قصير وطويل الأمد. أسعار شقق للبيع حي بطحاء قريش تتنوع أسعار الشقق في بطحاء قريش بما يناسب مختلف الميزانيات، ويمكن إلقاء نظرة تقريبية على متوسط الأسعار من خلال ما يقدمه موقع وصلت من عروض حصرية كالتالي: شقة للبيع بطحاء قريش 6 غرف بسعر 650 ألف ريال سعودي. شقة للبيع في بطحاء قريش 5 غرف بسعر 580 ألف ريال سعودي. شقة للبيع ببطحاء قريش 3 غرف بسعر 480 ألف ريال سعودي. فرص الاستثمار في شقق بطحاء قريش يُعتبر شراء شقق للبيع بحي بطحاء قريش من الفرص الاستثمارية الواعدة نظرًا لعدة أسباب تتمثل في: الطلب المتزايد : تستقطب المدينة ملايين الزوار سنويًا، ما يجعل الإيجارات الموسمية بها وخاصة خلال فترات الحج والعمرة مجزية.

text: فرص الاستثمار في شقق بطحاء قريش يُعتبر شراء شقق للبيع بحي بطحاء قريش من الفرص الاستثمارية الواعدة نظرًا لعدة أسباب تتمثل في: الطلب المتزايد : تستقطب المدينة ملايين الزوار سنويًا، ما يجعل الإيجارات الموسمية بها وخاصة خلال فترات الحج والعمرة مجزية. الاستثمار العقاري : يتسم قطاع عقارات مكة وخاصة عقارات للبيع في بطحاء قريش بالاستقرار مقارنة ببعض المدن الأخرى في المملكة. العائد الاستثماري المرتفع : يتميز التأجير أو إعادة البيع بالحصول على عائد مادي عالي خاصة خلال شهر رمضان وموسم الحج. سهولة البيع : يمكن إعادة بيع شقق بطحاء قريش بسهولة نظرًا للإقبال الكبير على المنطقة. مستقبل شقق للبيع حي بطحاء قريش من المتوقع أن تشهد العقارات في هذا الحي الراقي مزيدًا من الطلب نظرًا لاستمرار التطور في المنطقة خلال السنوات المقبلة. ويتسم مستقبل المشهد العقاري في الحي وخاصة فيما يخص الشقق بـ: زيادة الأسعار بشكل تدريجي ما يجعله مجالًا استثماريًا رابحًا. التوسع في المشاريع السكنية الحديثة ما يزيد من الخيارات أمام المشترين. التطوير الخدمي بما يتناسب مع طبيعة المدينة العالمية التي تستقبل الكثير من السياح والزوار.

text: متوسط سعر فيلا للبيع ابها حي المروة 3.594 ريال سعودي للمتر المربع. بالإضافة إلى فلل للبيع ابها، يمكن من خلال موقع وصلت استكشاف متوسط أسعار الفلل في المدن الأخرى أيضًا مثل فلل للبيع جازان وخميس مشيط وبريدة، كما يقدم الموقع الكثير من المعلومات التفصيلية الأخرى التي تساعد المستخدمين على اتخاذ قرار الشراء المناسب وتسهيل تواصلهم مع الملاك من خلال توفير وسيلتي اتصال إما عبر الاتصال الهاتفي أو الواتس آب. أين يمكن شراء فلل للبيع ابها؟ تحتوي مدينة أبها على الكثير من الأحياء الراقية التي يمكن شراء فلل للبيع ابها بها والتي تضم المقومات السكنية الهامة من مرافق وخدمات متنوعة، والسمات الاستثمارية المميزة كالبيئة الخصبة والأجواء الحيوية والأسعار المناسبة، ومن بين افضل احياء ابها لشراء الفلل ما يلي: حي القريقر ابها : يتميز هذا الحي بموقع استراتيجي في محيط العديد من الأحياء السكنية الفاخرة الأخرى مثل حي البديع وحي العرين، كما أنه يتميز بوجود جامعة الملك خالد به والتي تعد أشهر جامعة في المنطقة الجنوبية بالمملكة. حي العرين ابها: إنه أحد أفضل احياء ابها التي تتميز بالمساحة الكبيرة فضلًا عن معالمه الطبيعية الخلابة ومرافقه الترفيهية والخدمية المتنوعة.
